responsibility: This header declares tree_widget, the widget type for hierarchical tree diagrams in GCC’s text-art system. It exposes factory helpers for building tree nodes from styled text, formatted output, or dump_widget_info context, the child-management API, and the widget overrides for sizing, child allocation, and painting themed tree connectors around an optional node widget.
same_name_distinction: Declares the tree_widget subclass, its factory APIs, and child-management surface; unlike gcc/text-art/tree-widget.cc, it does not implement tree layout or themed connector painting.
